Hana: quick game: describe your current mood in exactly two emojis. no explanations.
Gabe: :fried_egg: :running_shoe: breakfast sprint
Marta: :brain: :coffee: thinking + fuel
Leo: :cactus: :hourglass_flowing_sand: surviving slowly
Dotty: :sparkles: :zzz: pretending to sparkle while napping
Hana: rules: if you post :zzz: you must bring napkins to the snack table this week :wink:
Gabe: noted. napkin economy secured.
Marta: tiny poll: pastry stash Friday? react :croissant: for croissants, :donut: for donuts, :cookie: for cookies
Leo: :donut:
Dotty: :croissant:
Gabe: :cookie:
Hana: also micro-challenge: best one-line office survival tip wins the unofficial crown.
Marta: "Label your chargers like your future depends on them."
Leo: "If you heated it, own it (and the microwave smell)."
Dotty: "Bring one nice pen, hide ten mediocre ones."
Gabe: "Respond to calendar invites like you're training for a punctuality olympics."
Hana: vote with reactions for the Survival Tip Crown. crown wearer gets to rename the meeting room whiteboard doodle for the week.
kudos-bot: Hana awarded a kudos to Dotty for consistently leaving the kitchen cleaner than found. +1 karma
Dotty: small victory dance for kitchen cleanliness.
Marta: wrap-up: pastry winner announced in 15. crown poll closing soon. may the quirkiest tip prevail :tada:
